description: Mark Linux game compatibility database. Records the recommended Wine/Proton runtime, graphics translation layer and classification status for Windows games. Statuses: supported, partially_supported, unsupported, requires_official_developer_support. Performance claims require a recorded benchmark on the same hardware and configuration.

entries.notes: DirectX 9 content is translated through DXVK to the native Vulkan driver. No Mark Linux benchmark has been recorded for this title yet.
DirectX 12 content is translated through VKD3D-Proton to the native Vulkan driver. Requires a supported GPU (Vulkan-capable) and has not been tested on Mark Linux hardware yet.
Mixed DirectX 9 and DirectX 11 content may require both DXVK and per-game configuration. Shader cache and pipeline cache behaviour still depends on the upstream runtime.
